framings.text: PROVISIONAL: You want to become the final human judge of a durable, cohesive development experience that carries intuition through to a trustworthy, review-ready change while preserving the health and future ease of the codebase.

supports.quote: it should operate like a michellin star resteraunt and I am the resterauntaur that tastes the final delicious product.

it goes from this part (the brain dump-the prompt-the hunch-the intuition) all the way to a PR that is ready to be reviewed by human that considers the health of the code base and makes the next change easier.

framings.text: PROVISIONAL: You want a human-first coordinating harness spanning the agentic software-development lifecycle, with rigor, verification, and durability that compound across both the harness and the codebases it helps change.

supports.quote: a system that compounds itself and serves as a meta harness.
a human first board for coordinainting work from the entire continuum of agentic software development lifecycle
that has the rigor and durability and cohesive and verification that all 'just work's and thinks about the future of any code base it works on.

outcome: PROVISIONAL: You experience a coherent, trustworthy path from an initial hunch to a human-reviewable change, with the resulting codebase healthier and easier to change, while you judge the finished result rather than continuously producing or supervising it.

questions.text: Should “compounds itself” primarily mean the harness improves through use, the codebases become easier to change, or both?

alternatives.label: Human-first lifecycle board
alternatives.benefit: Could make the full journey visible, coordinated, and verifiable while keeping you as final judge.
alternatives.cost: May require substantial modeling and disciplined upkeep across many lifecycle stages.

alternatives.label: Compounding review-and-change workflow
alternatives.benefit: Could focus effort on producing healthier, increasingly easier-to-change code through repeatable feedback loops.
alternatives.cost: May cover less of the broader coordination experience and may not make the harness itself compound.
